text:
Maya Chen: handing off Atlas Health (enterprise) post-sign - quick snapshot: onboarding target = 3 weeks, health = moderate. Main open items: security review (data residency), request for private/VPC deploy evaluation, exec asked for detailed cost estimate tied to deployment options. Renewal watch: CFO signaled budget review next quarter.

Luis Ortega: thanks Maya. i'll take CS lead. can you paste the deal's checklist and any known blockers?

Maya Chen: pasted below + internal link: https://redwood.internal/accounts/atlas-health
- Kickoff + stakeholder intro
- Provisioning: org, quota, envs
- SSO/SCIM + test users
- Private deploy spike (customer-supplied infra?)
- Prod test keys & monitoring

Priya Nair: i'll open a spike to validate private deploy path and check infra requirements (HSM, network egress rules). tagging eng/security.

Priya Nair: Jira created:
```
Project: ENG
Type: Spike
Summary: Atlas Health - private/VPC deploy feasibility + SSO
Assignee: Priya Nair
Priority: P0
Notes: include infra checklist, rough ETA for a PoC (days), and any compliance blockers (HSM/KMS)
```

JiraBot: ENG-7942 created by Priya Nair - https://jira.redwood/ENG-7942

DevOpsBot: automated note - provisioning template v2 available: https://docs.internal/provisioning/v2 (includes quota request steps).

Luis Ortega: for support handoff, Tom in Support should preload common connectors and a minimal test plan. @Tom can you confirm?

Tom R.: yes i can. i'll add a shareable test checklist to ENG-7942 and request quotas. one potential blocker: our compliance team may require HSM-backed keys for this customer's data residency. i'll ping Security.

Maya Chen: intro: connected Atlas PO + security lead. PO asked for tentative dates for enablement and for the cost breakout.

Luis Ortega: next steps (owners): (1) Maya to confirm PO & security contacts (done). (2) Priya to deliver private-deploy feasibility + ETA on ENG-7942. (3) Support (Tom) to prepare test plan + connectors. (4) CS (Luis) to schedule kickoff + first enablement session and capture exec signals. (5) Finance/pricing follow-up for CFO cost estimate.

Priya Nair: updated ENG-7942 with initial infra questions and requested HSM clarification. initial PoC ETA ~12 business days assuming no additional compliance gating. adding label: renewal/watch.

Tom R.: test plan added to ENG-7942 and quota requests submitted. Flagged security requirement to security-team channel.

Luis Ortega: scheduled onboarding kickoff + enablement: Tue 4/6 11am PT (30m). invite includes enablement playbook and a short feedback form to capture early signals.

Maya Chen: FYI exec ask: CFO needs an apples-to-apples cost comparison between hosted vs private deploy before their finance window closes. Sales is looped.

Luis Ortega: ack. i'll create a pricing follow-up and involve Solutions Eng. putting this into the account doc and the renewal watchboard.

Priya Nair: will post progress updates here as ENG-7942 advances. leaving a note: if HSM is required, PoC timeline may slip by ~1 week for procurement and config.

Tom R.: noted. once Security confirms, i'll adjust test plan and share remediation steps.

Maya Chen: thanks team. please add any customer exec notes to the account doc and tag me if blockers come up.

Luis Ortega: summary of action items posted to account doc. owners: CS=Luis, ENG spike=Priya (ENG-7942), Support=Tom, Sales/Maya=pricing handoff. we'll reconvene after the PoC estimate. :thumbsup:

JiraBot: ENG-7942 updated by Priya Nair

Priya Nair: quick update - preliminary infra answers received, ETA reaffirmed ~12 business days; will create a short deliverable with binary feasibility + list of gaps.

Tom R.:

Luis Ortega: closing this transfer thread for immediate pass-off; we'll continue progress posts in ENG-7942 and the account doc. please add one-pager success metrics after kickoff so we can track adoption/health.
